title: Greg McKeown (Essentialism) — 74-minute conversation with Eric on why 76% of founders regret selling
summary: Greg McKeown — two-time NYT-bestselling author of Essentialism and Effortless — hosts Eric for a 74-minute conversation on Incorruptible: shareholder primacy as a recent idea, why the 'best practices' generation of managers were taught to optimize for are value-destroying, and the structural solution.
blockquote: Most of the best practices we teach people about how things are to be made are bad. Not just not as good as they could be, but downright value destroying.
blockquote_source: Eric Ries on the Greg McKeown podcast
attribution_title: Two-time NYT-bestselling author of Essentialism and Effortless; keynote speaker; host, The Greg McKeown Podcast
